summary: The prepared source already contains the fix from commit 829138a31e4f464563defc35b10e3468542e9aa9: timeout termination no longer depends on pool_transfers_done. A focused regression fails against the fixing commit's parent and passes against the prepared base, including independent policy and timeout boundary cases.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-86862247ae73/venv/bin/python test_hiradix_prefetch_timeout_regression.py -v (from detached worktree at 829138a3^ with its python directory forced first on sys.path)
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: can_terminate_prefetch returned false after timeout when pool_transfers existed and pool_transfers_done was false. The log records the imported pre-fix source path.

Passing-after regression on the prepared base: timeout termination is independent of pending/completed pool transfers, a non-expired timeout does not terminate, best_effort terminates, and wait_complete does not terminate in this scheduler-side policy check. Four tests passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect and regression are deterministic Python control-flow in HiRadixCache.can_terminate_prefetch and do not execute a GPU kernel. No GPU result is claimed.

remaining_limitations: A live HiCache plus Mooncake read-timeout serving reproduction was not run because no Mooncake deployment/configuration or model weights were supplied.
The regression validates the exact timeout decision invariant, not full-model semantics, distributed execution, or Mooncake transport behavior.
The implementation fix predates this task and was merged as part of a broader PP consistency change; this PR adds focused regression coverage and evidence only.
